replies.author: The_Detonator_
replies.body: Hi. We do not usually accept image evidence as viable for hacking, but as this is a fly mod, we usually could. However. The images are too low of a resolution and taken too far from the player to allow us to punish them. However, I thank you for the report and encourage you to actively report disobedient players in the future.
